note: Provenance of every recording in the dataset. Clips used to tune the rep counter are development material (split dev). Held-out recordings made by the team on 25 October 2026 go in with split test and are never used for selection. Six long YouTube CC BY sets were added on 25 Oct 2026 ~05:50 as development data (found by metadata licence filter; three share one subject, grouped by person in cross-validation).

splits.dev: grouped leave-one-recording-out cross-validation for model selection and the development results
splits.test: locked; evaluated once after the configuration is frozen
